name: Gunnar Johnson
headline: GUNNAR JOHNSON IS A TOP TIER INFIELDER🔥📈
report:
Gunnar Johnson | SS/3B/RHP | 2028 | 5’10 | 175

💎 Gunnar Johnson is a rising 2028 infielder out of Hickory, North Carolina, ranked by Prep Baseball as the No. 4 third baseman in the state’s 2028 class. The South Charlotte Panthers standout brings a stout, athletic build.

💥 Johnson swings with intent and does damage when he squares one up, driving the baseball hard into the gaps. His blend of consistent contact and real power potential makes him a tough out in the middle of a lineup.

⚡️ On the dirt, Johnson moves quickly at shortstop and third base, plays with a strong feel for his body and shows a fluid arm across the diamond. He also takes the mound as a right-hander, adding another layer to his value.

With a dangerous bat and two-way value, Johnson is a 2028 North Carolina prospect to know.
coachReport: Profile: 2028 SS/3B/RHP from Hickory, North Carolina. South Charlotte Panthers. 5'10", 175 lb.

name: Juan Duque
headline: JUAN DUQUE IS A FLAMETHROWER🔥📈
report:
Juan Duque | RHP | 2028 | 6’3 | 180 | Bishop Moore Catholic High School

🎯 Juan Duque is a long, athletic 2028 right-hander out of Orlando, Florida who recently committed to Florida Gulf Coast University. The SBA Bolts National arm pairs a projectable 6’3 frame with an arm that already plays at a high level.

🔥 On the mound, Duque runs his fastball up to 92 mph, giving him real power stuff for his class. His head coach calls him an impact arm, and his size and arm strength give him a strong foundation to work from.

📈 There is plenty left in the tank too. With more strength still to add to his frame, Juan has clear room to keep building velocity as he matures.

As Bishop Moore's newest Division I commit, Duque is a 2028 Florida arm with the tools to make an impact at the next level. ⚾️

⚾️ On the mound, Pierson brings advanced arm strength for his class, and his size gives him a strong foundation to keep adding velocity as he develops.

name: Titus Marasco
headline: TITUS MARASCO
report:
🔥 Titus Marasco is a talented 2029 prospect out of Olathe, Kansas who pairs a productive left-handed bat with real versatility. The Kansas City Royals Scout Team standout has become a key bat in the heart of the order.

💥 At the plate, Marasco takes a direct path to the baseball and looks to do damage to his pull side. That intent showed up all summer, as he hit .507 with a .619 on-base percentage and a 1.303 OPS. His mix of contact and pop makes him a tough out.

⚡️ Defensively, Marasco offers the flexibility to handle shortstop, second base and the outfield for his team.

With a dangerous lefty bat and the ability to play all over the diamond, Marasco is a 2029 Kansas prospect who belongs on every follow list. 👀📈

name: Thomas Terravecchia
headline: THOMAS TERRAVECCHIA IS AN ELITE ARM📈
report:
🔥 Thomas Terravecchia is a promising 2029 right-hander out of Wantagh, New York who has already earned a role on varsity. The Giac Squad arm brings a competitive edge and continues to show real growth.

⚾️ On the mound, Terravecchia attacks hitters with a fastball that tops in the low 80s. As a freshman on varsity, he posted a 3.45 ERA with 31 strikeouts over 42.2 innings, holding his own against older competition. He carried that momentum into the summer, recording a 1.08 ERA with Giac Squad.

⚡️ With a live arm and a strong frame to keep building on, Thomas has the tools to keep climbing as he matures.

Backed by varsity experience and an arm that keeps trending up, Terravecchia is a 2029 New York pitcher to keep tabs on. 👀📈

name: Eduardo Vázquez
headline: EDUARDO VÁZQUEZ IS A JACK OF ALL TRADES🧤📈
report:
🔥 Eduardo Vázquez is an athletic 2028 prospect out of Barranquitas, Puerto Rico who brings versatility, a lean athletic frame and plenty of projection to the diamond. The Puerto Rico Scout Team standout has the tools to make an impact in several different ways.

💥 At the plate, the right-handed hitter works with an easy, low-effort swing and has shown the ability to put the ball in play with quality contact. As his frame continues to add strength, his bat speed and impact should keep climbing, giving him real offensive upside as he develops.

⚡️ Defensively, Vázquez gives his coaches options all over the field, with experience at second base, shortstop and around the infield. He moves well to his glove side and brings raw arm strength across the diamond, the kind of tools that let him fit wherever his team needs him.

🎯 On the mound, Eduardo shows a loose, athletic delivery and gets down the mound well. He works with a fastball that has good angle to the plate along with a curveball and changeup, giving him a developing mix to build on.

With versatility, athleticism and a two-way skill set that's still growing, Eduardo Vázquez is a 2028 Puerto Rico prospect worth keeping an eye on! 👀📈

name: Beck Hoover
headline: Beck Hoover has unreal pop
report:
🔥 Beck Hoover is a 2027 prospect out of Charlotte, North Carolina who brings a long, athletic 6'1, 160-pound frame to the field. The Stampede Baseball Club standout offers an intriguing mix of length, athleticism and offensive ability.

💥 At the plate, Hoover pairs a good approach with plus bat speed, giving him the ability to do damage when he gets his pitch. He also shows good adjustability to stay on the barrel even when he's fooled, a trait that makes him a tough out and should keep paying off as he adds strength to his frame.

⚡️ Defensively, Hoover brings experience at shortstop and in the outfield. His length and athleticism give him a strong foundation at both spots and plenty of ways to impact the game.

With bat speed, a mature approach and a projectable frame, Hoover is a 2027 North Carolina prospect worth keeping an eye on! 👀📈

report:

name: Dylan Herbert
headline: Dylan Herbert has huge pop
report:
🔥 Dylan Herbert is a 2029 middle infielder out of Seaford, New York who brings elite energy, versatility and a well-rounded game to the diamond. The Kellenberg Memorial and Long Island Dodger Nation infielder is a very fast, twitchy athlete who impacts the game in a variety of ways.

💥 At the plate, the right-handed hitter has a contact-first approach with great pop, consistently putting the ball in play while showing the ability to drive it for extra bases. As he continues to add strength, his offensive profile has plenty of room to grow.

💨 Once on base, Herbert becomes a constant threat. His speed and instincts let him take extra bases and put pressure on the defense every time he reaches.

⚡️ Defensively, Herbert handles shortstop and second base, and he has also seen time at third base and in the outfield. His quick-twitch athleticism and versatility give his team plenty of ways to use him.

With game-changing speed, a contact bat and plenty of projection left, Herbert is a 2029 New York infielder worth keeping an eye on! 👀📈

name: Cole Corey

report:

🎯 On the mound, Corey works with the leverage and extension that come with a 6'2 frame, giving him a natural advantage from the left side. Pitching is his primary focus, and his size and athleticism give him a strong foundation to keep building on.

💪 Corey is putting in the work in the weight room to add strength to his frame, and as he fills out physically, there is plenty of room for his stuff to take another step forward.

💥 At the plate and at first base, Corey adds another dimension as a two-way option. His ability to contribute at first base gives his team flexibility when he is not on the mound.

With size, projection and a left-handed arm with plenty left to unlock, Corey is a 2028 New York prospect worth keeping an eye on! 👀📈
